name: nrg2iso
desc: Extract ISO9660 data from Nero nrg files
why: Pulls ISO data out of Nero's proprietary disc image format, a small dive into an obscure file format.

brief.what_it_is: Nrg2Iso is a small command-line utility that converts a disc image made by Nero Burning Rom (an .nrg file) into a standard ISO image. It takes the .nrg file as its first argument and writes an .iso file to the path given as its second argument. The page says it works for CD or DVD images and shows a progress bar during conversion.
brief.why_it_exists: The page frames it as a Linux tool for converting CD or DVD images generated by Nero Burning Rom into the ISO format. Nero's own format is not what most other tools expect, so this converts it.

commands_seen.context: Usage example from the Use section: converts the Nero image image.nrg into the ISO file image.iso. A progress bar shows conversion status.

brief.install_notes: The page gives no build or install steps. Downloads are listed on the page: version 0.4.1 is the latest, an RPM and SRPM for Suse 9.0 come from a third party (Bjørn Runden), and Win32 binaries come from another third party (Guenter Knauf). Nothing on the page mentions runtime dependencies or configuration. The Homebrew executable is named nrg2iso.
brief.standout: It does one narrow job: turning a proprietary Nero disc image into a plain ISO with a single command and no options shown. The page's usage section is one line long.
brief.status: quiet. The page is copyright 2003, 2004 and lists v 0.4.1 as the latest release, with no later release date or commit history visible on the page. I did not check a repository or the Homebrew formula, so the current state is unknown beyond what this page shows.
brief.caveats: The homepage is old (copyright 2003, 2004) and describes the tool as a Linux util. The Win32 binaries are third-party builds, not from the author. The page says nothing about which Nero versions or disc layouts are supported, and it names no maintained source repository. The page's example usage is the only documented interface. The DVD support is mentioned only as a patch credit, not described in detail.
quotes: Nrg2Iso is a linux utils for converting CD (or DVD) image generated by Nero Burning Rom to ISO format.
Use of Nrg2Iso is very simple !
A progress bar gives the status of the conversion.
